The outlined treatment plan for Grace's osteoarthritis is highly appropriate and aligns with standard clinical guidelines. Osteoarthritis management typically focuses on symptom relief and improving joint function without invasive procedures. The recommendation to use over-the-counter pain relievers addresses acute pain management. Low-impact aerobic exercises like swimming and biking are ideal because they maintain cardiovascular health and joint mobility while minimizing stress on the knee joints. Furthermore, physical therapy aimed at strengthening the muscles surrounding the knees provides better joint stability and support, which can reduce pain and slow disease progression. This multimodal approach is conservative, effective, and patient-centered.
